scope: A separate core-only observation variance fitter; no Stata, FFI, match, point-estimation or q1-formula changes.

inputs.basis: Borrowed outcome-free row-major Z, 1 to 15 columns, first column one; intended callers supply the existing 3-term leverage or 15-term common basis. No data-dependent column deletion.
inputs.leverage: Exact full-model diag(P), unit-frequency independent observation rows. Approximate JLA diagonals are not qualified by this slice.
inputs.projection: Caller-owned full-model projection action, one certified complete original-system residual per probe; no grounded production solve.
inputs.residual: Full-model e = (I-P)y on the identical rows; known deterministic Z and P, not an independent cross-fit claim.

method.gram: Z'diag(1-2h)Z + one half the unbiased sample covariance of Z'(Pg)^2
method.probe_distribution: Counter-V1 Gaussian numerical probes in a new separate domain; canonical entity/subdraw addresses, ascending unique pairs, fixed stream before outcomes
method.accumulation: Compensated row sums and symmetric centered Welford covariance; fixed logical probe order independent of batching
method.fit: Unregularized inverse(Khat) Z'e^2; no ridge, coefficient clipping, column dropping or fallback
method.positivity: Floor predictions at 1e-8 times median(e^2/(1-h)); report raw nonpositive and floor counts; fail on invalid scale or entirely floored fit
method.qualification_caveat: Finite-probe inversion and positivity flooring need not preserve the exact-K unbiasedness identity.

local_gates: Independent dense M-squared moment identity, exact-K noiseless variance recovery and homoskedastic SSR/(n-rank) special case
